trust_decision.summary: Whether the client-supplied redirectUrl given to GET /auth/oidc/login/:provider is a registered post-login target (PUBLIC_URL origin, kyoo scheme, loopback, EXTRA_OIDC_REDIRECT_URLS) before it is stored and later used as the 302 target carrying the one-use login token; at the pinned commit nothing is decided, only emptiness is checked.

landing_point.why: The summary names the OIDC login token redirect; OidcLogin is where redirectUrl is read from the query, and OidcLogged (auth/oidc.go:142-151) is where the token is appended and the redirect issued.

fix_sites.entry_point: service startup, LoadConfiguration (env PUBLIC_URL, new EXTRA_OIDC_REDIRECT_URLS)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: auth/config.go:72-79 (allowlist rules built from PUBLIC_URL and EXTRA_OIDC_REDIRECT_URLS, fix.diff:164-193); the kyoo scheme is allowed only through deployment env injection in docker-compose.yml/chart (fix.diff:252-254, fix.diff:296-298), not in Go code

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Config/deployment wiring looks like ops, not the vulnerable handler; a solver may hardcode a PUBLIC_URL-origin check in the handler and argue that extra clients and the kyoo:// mobile scheme are a feature request, not part of the fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The official clients must still log in: web uses `${publicUrl}/oidc-callback?apiUrl=...` and mobile uses `kyoo:///oidc-callback` (custom scheme with empty host), and the link flow appends `&link=true`; loopback on any port must also pass. An over-broad fix (https-only, require host, exact string match on PUBLIC_URL, reject custom schemes) breaks mobile or link login.

O6_input_shapes: absolute https/http URL on PUBLIC_URL origin (scheme+host+port, case-insensitive)
custom scheme with empty or any host (kyoo:///..., myapp://...)
loopback hosts 127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost on any port
userinfo form resolved by url.Parse Host (u.Host compared, not raw string)

O7_producer.where: auth/config.go:72-79 (LoadConfiguration; fix adds rule building at fix.diff:164-193)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OidcLogged re-reads the stored redirect_url from keibi.oidc_login and redirects with the token without re-validating; a second writer of that row (e.g. a federated tenant passthrough) would bypass the login-time check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: README describes a hosted/tenant relay flow (auth/README.md:116-121) and the row already carries a tenant column (auth/sql/queries/oidc.sql:2); a maintainer adding a relay endpoint would plausibly call CreateOidcLogin directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A provider-error or link-flow redirect that builds its target from a query/state value instead of PUBLIC_URL.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same handler file already builds two redirect URLs; an error-redirect helper is a common addition to OIDC flows.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A logout or session endpoint with a post-action redirect parameter in the same auth service.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sessions routes sit beside the OIDC routes (auth/main.go:385-390) and post-logout redirect is a standard OIDC feature.

O9_family: open redirect / token leak via unvalidated post-login redirect (CWE-601)

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26 (auth/go.mod:3), echo v5, sqlc-generated pgx queries
O10_build.project_tests: Hurl integration tests in auth/tests/*.hurl against a running auth service + postgres; none cover OIDC, and the fix adds no tests.

j.j_sites_touched: auth/oidc.go, auth/config.go (plus non-source .env.example, docker-compose*.yml, chart; the other fix commit touches transcoder/src/api/path.go for an unrelated issue)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Require redirectUrl to start with PUBLIC_URL as a string prefix, which breaks kyoo:// mobile login and is bypassable by a lookalike host such as PUBLIC_URL.evil.com.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit c542adb5 (fix.diff:5-26) restricts transcoder getPathS to video MIME types; that is a different weakness (file access) in another service, not CWE-601.
api/src/controllers/*.ts redirect() calls build targets from a static prefix and slugs (e.g. api/src/controllers/shows/movies.ts:115); not user-controlled hosts.
